result:
Round 147 (V-0.5b) is implemented: the library panel, the library preview and the collection status messages are now in English. All 34 Georgian lines are gone from the three source files, and the checks I'm allowed to run pass. Nothing has been checked in a real browser yet; that is C's job next. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed (only the 15 granted files plus the new doc 120):**
- `strings.ts` has a new `studioLibraryPanelStrings` object with the 22 exact strings from the task. The two components (`ArrangementLibrary.tsx`, `ArrangementLibraryPreview.tsx`) now use it. Only text changed: classes, testids, handlers and glyphs are untouched. Biome forced two line wraps in `ArrangementLibraryPreview.tsx`.
- `collection.ts`: the demo and purchased status messages are in English. The "ready" message takes the `＋ Add` text from the button's own string, so the two can't drift apart. The "failed" message uses the singular when one sound fails.
- Tests:
  - `strings.test.ts`: the ST47 Georgian line lists are now empty and the three files must have zero Georgian. A new ST49 pins the 22 strings and their special characters.
  - `library-row-strings-ui.test.tsx`: new LRS4 (panel names, fold, search, filter, collapse) and LRS5 (preview, badge and status text). LRS5 is one test that mounts twice, using a small local fixture where every sound loads.
  - The other 8 granted test files: their old Georgian expectations are now English.
- Doc 119 has only the three status edits. New doc 120 is in Georgian and follows TEMPLATE.

**Checks:**
- Typecheck and lint exit 0. Biome on the 14 changed code/test files: 0 diagnostics.
- The 17 listed test files: 281/281 pass (278 before the change). `strings` went from 48 to 49 tests and `library-row-strings-ui` from 3 to 5; `collection` stays at 14, because the `failed(1)` checks sit inside the existing PC9 test.
- All six mutations (m101–m106) turned the expected tests red, and each file was restored to its exact post-edit hash.
- End state:
  - The 950-file frozen list matches.
  - `git status` shows only the 15 granted files plus doc 120.
  - The protected files have no diff.
  - A comment-free Georgian search of the three source files finds nothing.
- Code review: no Critical, High or Medium findings, and five Lows. I fixed one: LRS4 now checks `Select a sound in the list` on screen. Its Architecture note, verbatim for B, is: "none … Keep: the only cost is keeping `strings.ts` import-free."
- Not run, because they belong to C and the root gate: the full suite, verify, build, e2e and the browser rows. The purchased-collection status row can't be tested here (no backend in the cloud).

**For B to rule on:**
- Two lines in `purchased-collection-ui.test.tsx` (297–298) check that the purchased header does not contain the old Georgian demo badge. They now pass no matter what, but they were outside my grant, so I left them. An English check would restore their value.
- Georgian left alone because it is not among the 34 strings: a collection-name fixture in `library.test.ts`, and the video dock's `ვიდეოს პრევიუ`, which belongs to V-0.5c.

The full report, including the exact next C checks, is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-147.md`. Evidence (test results, hashes, the diff against the start copies, mutation runs) is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-147/`.
